title: Selected projects
lede: A few recent spaces from across Hyderabad.

items.description: A Jubilee Hills apartment in soft greys, oak and diffused daylight — planned for rest without losing warmth.
Rounded arches, pale timber and linen upholstery keep this open home uncluttered and easy to live in.
A HITEC City penthouse office with acoustic lounges, skyline views and a calm, hospitality-led reception.
